notes:
# Zoom's windows are found by what they ARE, not what they are called {camcorder}
On some Macs this app could not see a single one of Zoom's windows, and
everything that depends on seeing them quietly stopped working: a share was
never noticed, so recording while you presented produced a run that waited
for a meeting window until it gave up; the offer to record the screen
instead never appeared; and a recording could come back with nothing in it.
Nothing was wrong with the Mac or its permissions -- Zoom's windows were
being looked up by the NAME macOS shows for the app, and that name is not
the same on every Mac or every version of Zoom. They are looked up by the
app's identifier now, which is the same everywhere. The last release
claimed to fix recording while sharing "on every Mac" and could not have:
on the Macs that were affected it was asking a question that had no answer
there.

---

Everything else in this release:

- When a run cannot find Zoom's meeting window, the log now says WHICH of
  the three reasons it is -- the windows are there and named, they are
  there but unreadable, or nothing matched Zoom at all -- and lists what is
  on screen. The line used to blame Screen Recording permission for all
  three, which is the one thing it was not: it sent a whole round of
  diagnosis after a permission that had been granted the entire time.
